baseline.meaning: Earlier development run, before the Speckit-label parser correction. Only its actually observed plain-output and syntax exit codes form numeric baseline fields. Different fixture counts are not a like-for-like quality improvement or product baseline.

threshold_provenance: Expected exit codes and error codes are literal assertions in the archived verifier. CLI zero-exit syntax/plain thresholds are contract expectations, not post-hoc numeric quality thresholds. This is not an LLM evaluation.

calibration.meaning: This report archives synthetic mechanical fixture/oracle inputs and expected/observed CLI cases; no fitted or numerical calibration run occurred. Fixtures informed implementation and are not held-out.

holdout.meaning: Actual documentation of the subsequent whole-repository acceptance protocol and parsing exclusions. This reference is NOT a blind holdout dataset; no independent holdout-quality score is claimed.

human_anchor.meaning: Repository governance and human-review requirement only; neither human-labelled link judgments nor a named reviewer approval were collected.

synthetic_replay_material.limitation: Archived runtime fixture bytes were collected at assembly. The verifier reconstructs its own fixtures; the authoritative executed evidence is the hashed final log. This archive was not independently rerun.

limitations: HTTP(S), mailto ve diğer dış şemalar doğrulanmaz; yalnız sayılır.
CommonMark ayrıştırıcısı değildir: iç içe liste/alıntı kod blokları, girintili kod, MDX, ham HTML bağlantıları ve çıplak URL'ler kapsam dışıdır.
Tanımsız kısa [etiket] veya boşluk/satır geçişiyle ayrılmış [P] [US1] metni bağlantı sayılmaz; tanımlı boşluklu referanslar, bitişik [metin][etiket] ve [etiket][] doğrulanır.
Referans tanımları tek satır olmalıdır; başlık slug'ları yaygın Markdown/GitHub biçimini ve Unicode harfleri destekler, tam HTML entity kataloğu içermez.
Markdown dışındaki fragmentler yalnız #Lsatır ve #Lbaşlangıç-Lbitiş biçiminde doğrulanır; diğerleri açıkça kontrol dışı raporlanır.

final_repository_scan.limitation: Default scan covers tracked Markdown only; untracked new Markdown needs an explicit separate check. No external URL checks.

limitations: ENGEL: Historical scan contains 30 broken local paths in immutable evidence documents outside I6 edit ownership; this dossier does not repair or waive them.
No independent blind holdout, human link-label calibration, real-provider, hosted CI, staging, canary, production or measured rollback evidence.
No HTTP(S) network validation and no full CommonMark/MDX conformance; parser limitations remain those in docs/link-checking.md.
All reviewer roles are unresolved requirements; there is no named human approval. No deployment or production-readiness claim.
privacy: Only generated synthetic fixtures, public source paths, commands, hashes and timestamps. No database, user session, provider credential or identifiable student payload.
